utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, I heard you're organizing a repair drive — need me to grab any tools from the hardware store while I'm out?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, that'd be swell, Ira — I could use a couple of sturdy screwdrivers and maybe some heavy-duty tape if they have it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing, Eli — I'll swing by the hardware store and pick those up for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I heard something about a repair drive, but I didn't catch all the details. What's it for again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's to fix broken tools and appliances people bring in. Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday at the community center, got it. I'll try to drop by if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that repair drive? I haven't seen any official notice about it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: No, I haven't seen anything official either, and that's exactly what worries me. Who's even organizing this thing?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Exactly my point. Without any official backing, it could be just a rumor.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... what's it for again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's a community effort to collect spare parts and tools for fixing up broken appliances and furniture around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right! I think I've got an old toaster in the garage that might be useful. I'll dig it out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What exactly is the repair drive? I want to make sure I understand before we move forward.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? It's that little USB stick we keep by the community board, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, that's the one. I just wanted to confirm there's nothing else we should know before we use it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I'm late — what did I miss about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries! We were just talking about organizing a community repair drive for old electronics and small appliances. Interested?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that sounds great! I've got a broken toaster and an old laptop that could use some love — count me in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Gus, I heard you're starting that repair drive for the community center. Need a hand hauling any tools or materials?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Sam, that'd be great! I've got a truckload of donated tools to bring over, and an extra pair of hands would speed things up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, just let me know when you want to load up and I'll be right there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I saw a gray van with a dented side panel turn onto Maple Street about twenty minutes ago—could be the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that might be them—I was told they’d be coming by around now to fix the school’s fence. Did you see anyone get out?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No, I didn’t see anyone get out—it just pulled around the corner and parked near the old oak tree.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, have you heard about the repair drive they're organizing down at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I sure have! I was just about to head over and grab a flyer to pass around the block. You interested in helping out?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely! I've got a few old tools I can donate, and I'm free Saturday morning to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly is wrong with your car that you need the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not entirely sure, honestly. It's been making a strange noise, but I haven't had a chance to look into it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you check the oil or look under the hood yet?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Nell, I heard the repair drive is happening Saturday—are you planning to bring that old lawnmower of yours?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I'm not sure yet—what's the timing for Saturday? I might bring it if I can get it started.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's supposed to run from 9 to 3, so there's plenty of time—I keep telling everyone to come by early if they can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Uli, I'm so glad you stopped by—we're trying to get a headcount for the repair drive next Saturday. Can I count you in?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll try to make it. Not sure I can stay the whole time, though.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's absolutely fine—any help, even for an hour, makes a big difference. Just let me know when you can come so I can plan the tasks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Eli, you catch wind of that neighborhood repair drive they're organizing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, I heard a little about it. Sounds like a good idea if they stick to a proper schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I heard they're planning it for this Saturday down at the community center. Should be a good chance to get our stuff fixed up for free.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I'm late. What's the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard they're planning it for this Saturday, but I'm not sure of the details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Saturday, huh? Well, better late than never. Do we know what tools we'll need?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The repair drive? I've heard some talk, but I don't know much about it yet. What's it all about?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's a community effort to fix up the old playground equipment. I've been meaning to help, but... things have been a bit heavy lately.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm sorry to hear that. If you need someone to talk to, I'm around.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Opal, I heard something about a repair drive—who's organizing it again?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've been hearing it's the community center folks, but I haven't seen an official sign-up sheet yet, so I can't say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Huh, okay—well, if you see a sign-up sheet, let me know. I might pitch in if it's not too complicated.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: You know, I think the repair drive could really bring the whole block together if we get the Smiths and the Lees on board too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Have you spoken with the Smiths or the Lees yet about the drive? I want to make sure we have their support before moving forward.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not yet, but I was thinking of stopping by the Lees' place this afternoon — want to come with me to ask them together?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, that thing... did we decide on a date yet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Not yet, but I was thinking Saturday the 14th might work—does that sound good to you?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday the 14th? Uh, maybe... let me check my calendar—I think I have something that day, but I might be mixing it up with another week.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I haven't heard much about the repair drive. What's the latest?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I just know there's a bunch of us neighbors meeting Saturday morning to fix up old Mrs. Gable's fence. I'm bringing my hammer and a few extra tools if anyone needs 'em.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds like a good cause. I can swing by with some paint if the fence needs a fresh coat.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm not sure about the details yet, but I'm willing to help out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I'll bring my tools Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, I'll be there Saturday morning to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm a bit worried about the timeline for the repair drive. Do we have a backup plan if something goes wrong?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly are you worried might go wrong? I need specifics before I can think about backup plans.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, what if the weather turns bad, or we find more damage than expected? Without a solid timeline, we might run out of daylight or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh yes, I've been stockpiling extra nails and lumber—just in case we need them for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's great, Cleo! I'll make sure to add you to the list of folks bringing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Have you heard if the repair drive is still happening this weekend? I need to plan around drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think so, but I can't quite remember the details. Maybe check with someone else?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Alright, I'll double-check with a couple other neighbors. Thanks anyway, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Nell, I'm so glad you stopped by! We're gathering tools and supplies for the repair drive this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a repair drive? I've heard bits and pieces about it from folks around the block—what exactly do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Well, we're collecting any spare tools, screws, fabric scraps—anything folks can spare. And of course, we could always use extra hands on Saturday morning!
